title: Connections
subtitle: One-click setup for third-party services. OpenLoaf handles the configuration behind the scenes — no MCP tinkering required.
errorHint: Connection failed. Please check your configuration.
disconnectedHint: Service is offline. Restart the app to reconnect.
oauthReadyHint: OpenLoaf will open Notion's official authorization page in your system browser. Once you approve access, return here and OpenLoaf will detect it automatically.
oauthPendingHint: Waiting for you to finish the authorization in your browser. You can return here once it's done.
oauthPreparingHint: Fetching the authorization link from Notion. Your browser will open shortly.
oauthTimeoutHint: Authorization timed out. Please try again.
oauthExpiredHint: Authorization session expired. Please start again.
oauthOpenFailed: Could not open the authorization page in your browser.
oauthPopupBlocked: Unable to open the authorization window. Please check your popup settings.
